|content1=
*'''Temp.no''' is founded by [[DaY]], [[cENTRYZ]], [[Polly]], [[MobY]] and [[Leffa]].
*April 4th - '''Temp.no''' replace [[MobY]] with [[prb]]. <ref name="+prb 2013">{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/n/10429|date=2013-04-04|title=prb replaces MobY in Temp.no|author=[[lurppis]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>
*May 7th - '''Temp.no'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s roster is acquired by [[H2k Gaming]]. <ref name="Temp.no H2K">{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/n/10655|date=2013-05-06|title=H2k Gaming sign Temp.no|author=[[MIRAA]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>
*October 22nd - '''Temp.no''' announce their return by signing [[DaY]], [[cENTRYZ]], [[Leffa]], [[PAINT]], and [[REASTEN]]. <ref>{{cite web|url=http://tempteam.blogg.no/1382444512_tempno__back_in_busin.html|date=2013-10-22|title=Temp.no = Back in business|author=[[DaY]]|publisher='''Temp.no'''}}</ref><ref name="Temp.no October 2013">{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/n/11555|date=2013-10-24|title=Temp.no announce return|author=[[MIRAA]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>

|content2=
* '''Temp.no''' sign a new team comprised of [[RUBINO]], [[hoyland]], [[Skurk]], [[Polly]], and [[maak]].
*January 18th - '''Temp.no''' is signed by [[H2k Gaming]]. <ref name="h2k gaming re-sign temp.no">{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/n/11949|date=2014-01-17|title=H2k Gaming sign Temp.no|author=[[hungipham]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>
*'''Temp.no''' is refounded by [[cENTRYZ]], [[DaY]], [[moen]], [[andz]] and [[KORN]].

|content3=
*August 19th - The roster is signed by [[BX3 eSports Club]].

|content4=
*January 15th - The team reforms after [[aNdz]], [[KORN]] and [[moen]] are released by [[BX3 eSports Club]]; [[DaY]] and [[cENTRYZ]] complete the roster. <ref name="Temp.no January 2016">{{cite web|url=http://www.gamer.no/artikler/e-sport-bx3-skifter-ut-hele-counter-strike-laget/224773|date=2016-01-15|title=BX3 skifter ut hele Counter-Strike-laget fem måneder etter signering|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|trans_title=BX3 replacing the entire Counter-Strike team five months after signing|publisher=[[gamer.no]]}}</ref>
*March 22nd - The team is picked up by [[Epiphany Bolt]]. <ref name="Temp.no EB">{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/n/17376|title=Epiphany Bolt pick up Temp.no|date=2016-03-22|author=[[MIRAA]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>
*October 9th - [[aNdz]], [[KORN]] and [[PAINT]] reform the team after parting ways with [[Epiphany Bolt]]. <ref name="Temp.no October 2016">{{cite web|url=http://www.gamermag.no/epiphany-bolt-dropper-counter-strike-laget/|date=2016-10-09|title=Epiphany Bolt dropper Counter-Strike-laget|trans_title=Epiphany Bolt drop Counter-Strike team|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|author=[[cryztal]]|publisher=[[Gamermag.no]]}}</ref>

|content5=
*March 23rd - [[mystic]] is signed by [[Norse]]. <ref name="mystic to Norse">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/aNdzCSGO/status/844903861173309441|title=So sad we lost mystic to norse..|date=2017-03-23|author=[[aNdz]]}}</ref>
*November 8th - '''Temp.no''' rebrand to '''Kingpins Esports''', becoming a player-owned organization. [[becker]] and [[H4RR3]] join the roster. <ref name="Kingpins">{{cite web|url=https://www.gamer.no/artikler/e-sport-temp-blir-til-kingpins/411606|date=2017-11-08|title=Temp omdøpes til Kingpins og blir spillereid klubb|trans_title=Temp renamed to Kingpins and becomes a player club|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|author=[[hofern]]|publisher=[[gamer.no]]}}</ref>

|content6=
*January 3rd - '''Kingpins Esports''' announces the departure of [[Becker]]. <ref name="Becker leaves Kingpins">{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/notes/kingpins/henrik-becker-becker-forlater-klubben/2088714864681469/|title=Henrik «Becker» Becker forlater klubben|author='''Kingpins Esports'''}}</ref>
*January 6th - '''Kingpins Esports''' bring in [[Marcelious]] and [[nafu]] for their 2018 roster. <ref name="add Marc and nafu">{{cite web|url=https://www.gamer.no/artikler/e-sport-vi-har-akkurat-fullfort-lagoppstillingen-og-startet-med-treningen/426256|title=Vi har akkurat fullført lagoppstillingen og startet med treningen|publisher=[[gamer.no]]}}</ref>
*January 17th - '''Kingpins Esports''' part ways with [[KORN]] and [[PAINT]]. <ref name="KORN leaves Kingpins">{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/notes/kingpins/to-legender-ut-av-lagoppstillingen/2094313960788226/|title=To legender ut av lagoppstillingen|author='''Kingpins Esports'''}}</ref>
*January 24th - [[Marcelious]] and [[nafu]] depart to [[NOREG]]. <ref name="Kingpins add enix and Day">{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/notes/kingpins/kingpins-klar-for-telenorligaen/2101919293361026/|title'''Kingpins Esports''' klar for Telenorligaen|date=2018-01-29|author='''Kingpins Esports'''}}</ref>
*January 29th - '''Kingpins Esports''' announce their roster for 2018 by bringing back [[PAINT]] and signing [[enix]] and [[DaY]]. <ref name="Kingpins add enix and Day"/>
*February 4th - [[Mystic]] replaces [[H4RR3]] as he departs from '''Kingpins Esports'''. <ref name="H4RR3 departs Kingpins">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/Kingpinsesports/status/960146988422586368|title=Vi skiller lag med @H4RR3csgo. Vi ønsker han masse lykke til videre!|author='''Kingpins Esports'''}}</ref>
*March 1st - [[KORN]], [[NiTo]] and [[MV]] replace [[DaY]], [[enix]] and [[Mystic]]. <ref name="KORN, NiTo and MV in main roster">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/Kingpinsesports/status/969566289986510849|title=Vi spiller med aNdz, KORN, PAINT, NiTo og MV|trans_title=We are playing with aNdz, KORN, PAINT, NiTo and MV|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2018-03-01|author='''Kingpins Esports'''}}</ref>
*June 21st - [[KORN]], [[MV]] and [[NiTo]] leave '''Kingpins Esports'''; [[PAINT]] transfers to an organizational position after acquiring shares. <ref name="Roster update 1 half 2018">{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/notes/kingpins/veien-videre-med-csgo/2178528765700078/|title=Veien videre med CS:GO|trans_title=The road ahead with CS:GO|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2018-08-21|author='''Kingpins Esports'''}}</ref>
*August 21st - '''Kingpins Esports'''<nowiki>'</nowiki> roster for the second half of the year is finalized, with [[akEz]], [[H4RR3]], [[Marcelious]] and [[truth]] being signed. [[aNdz]] remains in the squad as an in-game leader. <ref name="New roster 2nd half 2018">{{cite web|url=https://www.gamer.no/artikler/e-sport-kingpins-ruster-opp-for-sesongstart-henter-fire-nye-spillere/443844|title'''Kingpins Esports''' ruster opp før sesongstart - henter fire nye spillere|trans_title'''Kingpins Esports''' arm before the new season - sign four new players|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2018-08-21|publisher=[[gamer.no]]}}</ref>
*September 20th - '''Kingpins Esports''' part ways with [[akEz]] and [[H4RR3]]. <ref name="akez and h4rr3 leave">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/Kingpinsesports/status/1042647571754377217|title=I dag kan vi meddele at @akezcsgo og @H4RR3csgo forlater klubben|trans_title=Today we announce that @akezcsgo and @ H4RR3csgo have left the club|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2018-09-20|author='''Kingpins Esports'''}}</ref>
*September 24th - '''Kingpins Esports''' acquire [[Grusarn]] and [[mikki]]. <ref name="grusarn and mikki">{{cite web|url=https://www.gamer.no/artikler/e-sport-overgangsbonanza-i-telenorligaens-overste-divisjon-i-counter-strike-go/446882|title=Overgangsbonanza i Telenorligaen|trans_title=Transfer bonanza in Telenorligaen|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2018-09-25|publisher=[[gamer.no]]}}</ref>
*October 15th - [[RashiiiE]] joins on trial, replacing [[mikki]]. <ref name="rashiiie">{{cite web|url=https://www.gamer.no/artikler/e-sport-mikki-benket-til-fordel-for-rashiiie-som-er-hentet-pa-provespill/448681|title=«mikki» benket til fordel for «RashiiiE» som er hentet på prøvespill|trans_title=«mikki» benched, replaced by «RashiiiE» on trial|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2018-10-15|publisher=[[gamer.no]]}}</ref>

|content7=
*January 3rd - [[truth]] leaves '''Kingpins Esports'''. <ref name="truth leaves">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/truthcsgo_/status/1080933850681733120|title=Jeg kommer ikke til å være en del av @Kingpinsesports i 2019|trans_title=I'm not going to be part of @Kingpinsesports in 2019|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2019-01-03|author=[[truth]]}}</ref>
*January 9th -  '''Kingpins Esports''' sign [[akEz]]. <ref name="akez joins 2019">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/Kingpinsesports/status/1083075594919784452|title=Velkommen tilbake, @akEzCS!|trans_title=Welcome back, @akEzCS!|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2019-01-09|author='''Kingpins Esports'''}}</ref>
*January 16th - '''Kingpins Esports''' rebrands to '''Apeks'''. <ref name="Apeks">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1085492483021258754|title=I dag blir vi Apeks!|trans_title=Today we are Apeks!|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2019-01-16|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*January 22nd - '''Apeks''' replace [[RashiiiE]] with [[Polly]], who joins on trial. <ref name="Polly trial">{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/n/25901|title=Polly makes return in Apeks|date=2019-01-22|author=[[Professeur]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>
*February 10th - [[Polly]] joins '''Apeks''' full time after a successful trial period. <ref name="Polly joins">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1094555335329751040|title=Da har vi gleden av å annonsere at veteranen Polly har signert en profesjonell kontrakt med Apeks ut 2019!|trans_title=We have the pleasure of announcing that Polly has signed a professional contract with Apeks lasting for the entirety of 2019|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2019-02-10|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*June 12th - '''Apeks''' sign [[truth]] and bench [[Marcelious]]. <ref name="truth joins">{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/n/27062|title=Apeks sign truth; bench Marcelious|date=2019-06-12|author=[[LucasAM]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>
*July 29th - [[Polly]] takes over the role of coach; [[Radifaction]] joins. <ref name="Radifaction replaces Polly">{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/notes/apeksgg/velkommen-radifaction/2482583908627894/|title=Welcome "Radifaction"|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2019-07-29|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*August 26th - [[aNdz]] transitions into being the team's analyst, while [[Marcelious]] returns from the bench. <ref name="marcel returns">{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/notes/apeksgg/marcelious-er-tilbake-i-aksjon/2505217236364561/|title=Marcelious er tilbake i aksjon!|trans_title=Marcelious is back in action!|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2019-08-26|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>

|content8=
*April 20th - '''Apeks''' bench [[Radifaction]]. <ref name="radi benched">{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/notes/apeksgg/radifaction-benkes/2717334401819509/|title=Radifaction benkes|trans_title=Radifaction benched|language={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|date=2020-04-20|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*June 15th - '''Apeks''' sign [[dennis]], [[Polly]] returns to his coach position. <ref name="+dennis">{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/notes/apeksgg/dennis-signerer-ut-2020-english-below/2764606410425641/|title=dennis signs contract for 2020|date=2020-06-15|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*August 16th - '''Apeks''' part ways with [[Radifaction]]. <ref name="radi leave">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1295037621589221377|title=Thanks for everyhing, @radifaction!|date=2020-08-16|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*September 8th - '''Apeks''' bench [[akEz]]. <ref name="akez benched">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1303317279246094336|title=A big decision as been made to bench @akEzCS|date=2020-09-08|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*September 13th - '''Apeks''' acquire [[Nasty]] from [[777 Esports]] on a trial basis until the end of the year. <ref name="nasty trial">{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/notes/apeksgg/velkommen-nasty-welcome-nasty/10158746846891350|title=Welcome «Nasty»|date=2020-09-13|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*October 14th - '''Apeks''' bench [[truth]]. <ref name="truth bench">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1316363237856817155|title=Update regarding our CS:GO roster|date=2020-10-14|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*October 19th - '''Apeks''' acquire [[jkaem]] from [[100 Thieves]]. <ref name="+jkaem">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1318130969019371520|title=Say hello to jkaem|date=2020-10-19|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*December 8th - '''Apeks''' bench [[Nasty]]. <ref name="-nasty">{{cite web|url=https://www.apeks.gg/update-csgo/|title=A update on our CS:GO roster|date=2020-12-08|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*December 31st - '''Apeks''' release [[truth]] and [[akEz]]. <ref name="truth akEz released">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1345002264512131078|title=As of today @akEzCS and @truthcsgo_ both are released from their contracts with Apeks|date=2021-01-01|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>

|content9=
*January 24th - [[jkaem]] is acquired by [[EXTREMUM]]. '''Apeks''' sign [[FREDDyFROG]], [[Relaxa]] and [[kreaz]] and bench [[Marcelious]]. <ref name="jkaem EXTREMUM">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/extremumgg/status/1353326850659913728|title=We are ready to show you another way – #OURWAY|date=2021-01-24|author=[[EXTREMUM]]}}</ref><ref name="+FREDDyFROG +Relaxa +kreaz">{{cite web|url=https://www.apeks.gg/we-have-signed-3-new-players/|title=We have signed 3 new players|date=2021-01-24|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*May 31st - [[Marcelious]] is loaned to [[777 Esports]] on a trial basis. <ref name="777 marcel trial">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1399380178237800448|title=Good luck @Marceliouscsgo and take care of him @777esports|date=2021-05-31|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*June 4th - '''Apeks''' bench [[kreaz]] and sign [[AcilioN]] from [[Copenhagen Flames]]. <ref name="-kreaz +AcilioN">{{cite web|url=http://www.apeks.gg/welcome-acilion/|title=WELCOME, «ACILION»!|date=2021-06-04|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*July 1st - [[kreaz]] and [[Marcelious]]' contracts with '''Apeks''' expire and they leave the team. <ref name="kreaz FA">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/kreazCS/status/1410589969744232456|title=I am now officially a free agent, I'd like to thank @apeksgg for the time!|date=2021-07-01|author=[[kreaz]]}}</ref><ref name="Marcelious FA">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/Marceliouscsgo/status/1410587883870765062|title=I dag går kontrakten min ut med @apeksgg og i den anledning vil jeg gjerne takke både administrasjonen og kollegaer jeg har hatt|lang={{Flag|no}} Norwegian|trans_title=Today my contract with @apeksgg expires and on that occasion I would like to thank both the administration and colleagues I have had |date=2021-07-01|author=[[Marcelious]]}}</ref>
*July 3rd - '''Apeks''' sign [[djL]] as an assistant coach. <ref name="+djL">{{cite web|url=http://www.apeks.gg/welcome-djl/|title=WELCOME «DJL»|date=2021-07-03|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*August 12th - [[Nasty]] is loaned to [[Foxed Gaming]]. <ref name="+Nasty loan">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1425878522946523136|title=Finally this happy guy is playing officials again!|date=2021-08-12|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*September 22nd - [[Grus]] steps down from the active lineup. <ref name="grus inactive">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1440633615470063631|title=@GrusCSGO will be taking some time off due to personal reasons|date=2021-09-22|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*November 11th - '''Apeks''' bench and transfer-list [[dennis]], [[FREDDyFROG]], and [[Relaxa]] ahead of the expiration of their contracts at the end of the year. <ref name="Swedes benched">{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/news/32785/apeks-set-for-a-fresh-start-as-they-transfer-list-four-players|title=Apeks set for a "fresh start" as they transfer-list four players|date=2021-11-11|author=[[Striker (Czech journalist)|Striker]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>
*December 16th - '''Apeks''' acquire [[nawwk]] from [[Ninjas in Pyjamas]]. <ref name="+nawwk">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1471525537155850242|title=One piece of the puzzle is in place!|date=2021-12-16|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*December 31st - [[dennis]], [[FREDDyFROG]], [[Relaxa]], [[Grus]], and [[Nasty]] part ways with '''Apeks''' upon the expiration of their contracts. <ref name="Swedes benched"/><ref name="-Nasty">{{inside source|source=Nasty}}</ref>

|content10=
*January 7th - '''Apeks''' acquire [[jkaem]] from [[EXTREMUM]]. <ref name="+jkaem 2022">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/he-is-back-jkaem-x-apeks-2-0/|title=He is back! Jkaem x Apeks 2.0|date=2022-01-07|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*January 8th - '''Apeks''' sign [[Chawzyyy]]. <ref name="+Chawzyyy">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1479890654033592322|title=A diamond in a rough|date=2022-01-08|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*January 9th - '''Apeks''' acquire [[STYKO]] from [[FunPlus Phoenix]] to complete the roster for 2022. <ref name="+STYKO">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1480253039059554311|title=The last piece of the puzzle!|date=2022-01-09|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*January 14th - [[djL]] is acquired by [[Ninjas in Pyjamas]] as their head coach. <ref name="-djL">{{cite web|url=https://nip.gl/pages/welcome-djl|title=Welcome djL|date=2022-01-14|publisher=[[Ninjas in Pyjamas]]}}</ref>
*March 22nd - '''Apeks''' sign [[vENdetta]] as their new analyst. <ref name="+vENdetta">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1506224660672823297|title=Welcome @vENdettaCSGO|date=2022-03-22|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*June  23rd - '''Apeks''' announce that [[AcilioN]] and [[Chawzyyy]] will be benched at the start of the summer player break. <ref name="acilion chawzy bench">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1539926684820013057|title=CS:GO Roster update|date=2022-06-23|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*July 15th - '''Apeks''' bench [[AcilioN]] and [[Chawzyyy]]. <ref name="acilion chawzy bench"/>
*August 5th - '''Apeks''' appoint [[kuben]] as the new head coach and transition [[Polly]] to the position of an assistant coach. <ref name="+kuben">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/hello-this-is-your-new-captain-speaking|title=Hello, this is your new captain speaking!|date=2022-08-05|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*August 7th - '''Apeks''' sign [[jL]]. <ref name="+jL">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/say-hello-to-our-youngster-jl/|title=Say hello to our youngster, “jL”|date=2022-08-07|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*August 8th - [[vENdetta]] is acquired by [[SKADE X]] as their new coach. <ref name="-vEN">{{cite web|url=https://www.skade.gg/8689|title=A new era in Norwegian esports|date=2022-08-08|publisher=[[SKADE]]}}</ref>
*August 11th - '''Apeks''' acquire [[shox]] from [[Team Liquid]]. <ref name="+shox">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/we-welcome-a-legend-to-apeks|title=We welcome a legend to Apeks!|date=2022-08-11|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*October 1st - '''Apeks''' release [[AcilioN]] and [[Chawzyyy]]. <ref name="-acilion -chawzy">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1576241274306588672|title=Today we say our final farewells to @AcilioNcs & @chawzyyy|date=2022-10-01|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*October 25th - '''Apeks''' bench [[shox]]. <ref name="bench shox">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1584862287965614080|title=After much deliberation, we have mutually agreed for shox to explore his options|date=2022-10-25|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*December 30th - '''Apeks''' acquire [[kyxsan]] from [[BLUEJAYS]]. <ref name="+kyxsan">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/kyxsan-ready-for-apeks/|title=“kyxsan” ready for Apeks|date=2022-12-30|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>

|content11=
*January 11th - '''Apeks''' release [[shox]]. <ref name="-shox">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1613101511445303296|title=Today we agreed to part ways with @shoxCSGO!|date=2022-01-11|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*June 22nd - [[kyxsan]] signs a contract extension with '''Apeks''', keeping him tied to the organization until the end of 2024. <ref>{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/kyxsan-extends-contract-until-end-of-2024|title=“kyxsan” extends contract until end of 2024|date=2023-06-22|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*June 30th - [[jL]] is acquired by [[Natus Vincere]]. Additionally, '''Apeks''' part ways with [[Polly]] upon the expiration of his contract. <ref name="-jL">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/jl-transfers-to-navi/|title=“jL” transfers to NAVI|date=2023-06-30|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref><ref name="-Polly">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/staff-update-csgo/|title=Staff update CS:GO|date=2023-03-23|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*July 1st - '''Apeks''' sign [[CacaNito]]. <ref name="+Caca">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/welcome-cacanito/|title=Welcome, “CacaNito”|date=2023-07-01|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*September 7th - '''Apeks''' part ways with [[kuben]] and promote [[mithR]] from [[Apeks Rebels]] as the new head coach. <ref name="+mithR">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/mithr-appointed-as-the-new-head-coach-for-the-cs-main-team/|title=“mithR” appointed as the new Head Coach|date=2023-09-07|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*October 4th - '''Apeks''' bench [[STYKO]] and promote [[sense]] on trial from [[Apeks Rebels]]. <ref name="-STYKO +sense">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/ending-our-tenure-with-styko|title=Ending our tenure with “STYKO”|date=2023-10-04|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*October 12th - '''Apeks''' sign [[stoick]] as an analyst. <ref name="+stoick">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/a-new-addition-to-our-counter-strike-team|title=A new addition to our Counter-Strike team!|date=2023-10-12|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*December 1st - [[nawwk]] signs a two-year contract extension with '''Apeks''', keeping him tied to the organization until the end of 2025. <ref>{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/nawwk-signs-for-two-more-years|title=“nawwk” signs for two more years|date=2023-12-01|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*December 21st - [[kyxsan]] is acquired by [[Heroic]]. <ref name="-kyxsan">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/kyxsan-departure|title=«kyxsan» departure |date=2023-12-21|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*December 27th - '''Apeks''' reinstate [[STYKO]] to the starting lineup as he signs a four-month contract extension until the end of March. <ref name="+STYKO 2024">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/the-return-of-martin-styko-styk|title=The return of Martin «STYKO» Styk|date=2023-12-27|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*December 30th - [[sense]] joins the main team on a permanent basis. <ref name="+sense">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/sense-transitions-to-permanent-member|title=sense transitions to permanent member|date=2023-12-30|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
|content12=
*March 13th - [[mithR]] signs a three-year contract extension with '''Apeks''', keeping him tied to the organization until 2027. <ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/news/38477/mithr-extends-contract-with-apeks-until-2027|title=mithR extends contract with Apeks until 2027|date=2024-03-13|author=[[Nohte]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}}</ref>
*May 1st - '''Apeks''' part ways with [[STYKO]] and [[stoick]] and transfer-list the remainder of their roster. <ref name="-STYKO">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1785670763170709590|title=It’s time to say farewell|date=2024-05-01|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref><ref name="roster bench">{{cite web|url=https://apeks.gg/2024/05/01/2654/apeks-transfer-list-entire-cs2-roster/|title=Apeks transfer list entire CS2 roster|date=2024-05-01|publisher='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*May 12th - [[nawwk]] and [[jkaem]] are acquired by [[BLEED Esports]]. <ref name="-nawwk -jkaem">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/apeksgg/status/1789626578336624749|title=Transfer of @jkaem & @nawwkcs to @ggBleed|date=2024-05-12|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*June 27th - [[CacaNito]] is acquired by [[BC.Game Esports]]. <ref name="-caca">{{cite web|url=https://x.com/BCGameEsports/status/1806341721850089474|title=We bet he will impress you!|date=2024-06-27|author=[[BC.Game Esports]]}}</ref>
*July 10th - '''Apeks''' release [[mithR]]. <ref name="-mithr">{{cite web|url=https://x.com/apeksgg/status/1811024724798918695|title=Today we can announce that we have terminated with our coach @mithRTV|date=2024-07-10|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
*August 4th - [[sense]] is acquired by [[Copenhagen Wolves (American organization)|Copenhagen Wolves]]. <ref name="-sense">{{cite web|url=https://x.com/apeksgg/status/1820118376020156886|title=After an incredible journey from our academy team to the main team, @sense2CS is moving on to new challenges|date=2024-08-04|author='''Apeks'''}}</ref>
